import-diagnostics.trade_level_reconstructed: This export lists whole trades; the entry and exit executions were rebuilt from the reported prices.
import-diagnostics.section_not_found: The expected statement section is missing from this file.
import-diagnostics.columns_unrecognized: These columns could not be recognized. Use the column mapping below.
import-diagnostics.symbol_required: Choose the symbol for this file before importing.
import-diagnostics.no_complete_executions: No complete executions could be imported from this file.
import-diagnostics.open_trades_skipped: {count, plural, one {# incomplete position was skipped; this export requires completed entry/exit pairs.} other {# incomplete positions were skipped; this export requires completed entry/exit pairs.}}
import-diagnostics.rows_skipped_invalid: Some rows lack valid prices, quantity, direction or timestamps and were skipped.
import-diagnostics.unmatched_deal_skipped: Line {row}: this deal has no matching position in the file and was skipped.
import-diagnostics.fee_credit_zeroed: Line {row}: a negative fee (credit) without a reported P&L was recorded as a zero fee.
import-diagnostics.pnl_basis_assumed: The "{column}" column does not state net or gross; it was used as net.
import-diagnostics.rows_skipped_journaled: {count, plural, one {# row could not be journaled and was skipped.} other {# rows could not be journaled and were skipped.}}
import-diagnostics.multiple_source_accounts: {count, plural, one {This file contains fills from # source account. Import one account at a time.} other {This file contains fills from # source accounts. Import one account at a time.}}
import-diagnostics.missing_source_account: Some rows have no source account. Keep the account column consistent when re-exporting.
import-diagnostics.no_execution_id: Some fills have no execution ID. Identical-looking fills cannot always be told apart across overlapping exports.
import-diagnostics.futures_multiplier_required: Set the contract multiplier in Settings for each imported futures symbol: {symbols}.
import-diagnostics.execution_invalid_commission: A row has an invalid commission. Correct it or leave it blank.
import-diagnostics.execution_invalid_effect: A row has an unrecognized Entry/Exit value. Export Entry, Exit or Reverse values.
import-diagnostics.execution_invalid_sequence: A row has an invalid execution sequence. Sequences must be non-negative whole numbers.
import-diagnostics.execution_id_conflict: One execution ID describes different fills. Export a consistent execution history.
import-diagnostics.position_labels_used: Open/Close labels keep long and short positions separate; closes are checked against the selected account when saving.
import-diagnostics.mixed_position_labels: {symbol}: this file mixes Open/Close labels with other actions. Export Open/Close labels for every fill of this contract.
import-diagnostics.invalid_position_fill: {symbol}: an Open/Close fill is missing a symbol, quantity, price or timestamp.
import-diagnostics.position_field_invalid: {symbol}: the {field} column is invalid on a position row.
import-diagnostics.input_truncated: This file appears to be truncated; part of the history may be missing.
import-diagnostics.malformed_csv: Some rows are malformed and were skipped.
import-diagnostics.unmapped_required_fields: Required columns could not be mapped from this file.
import-diagnostics.ambiguous_mapping: A column matches several fields. Check the column mapping.
import-diagnostics.row_recovered: Row {row} was recovered with assumptions; check the result.
import-diagnostics.duplicate_rows: Duplicate rows were collapsed into one import.
import-diagnostics.open_trade_excluded: An open position was excluded; completed trades only.
import-diagnostics.unmatched_entry: An entry has no matching exit and was skipped.
import-diagnostics.unmatched_exit: An exit has no matching entry and was skipped.
import-diagnostics.cancelled_row_ignored: A cancelled order row was ignored.
import-diagnostics.trade_id_reused: A trade ID is reused in the file; the trades were kept separate.
import-diagnostics.exit_before_entry: An exit precedes its entry; the pair was skipped.
import-diagnostics.direction_pnl_mismatch: A trade's direction contradicts its reported P&L.
import-diagnostics.pnl_derived_from_prices: P&L was derived from prices because the file does not report it.
import-diagnostics.futures_multiplier_unknown: A futures symbol has no multiplier in Settings; its P&L may be off.
import-diagnostics.invalid_number: A number could not be read; the row was skipped.
import-diagnostics.unsupported_format: This file's format is not supported.
